timecoded_text_to_speech.text: A Fort Worth facility, what we really want to do is help our couples get pregnant and we
really believe this is the place for them.
We can provide them with the best care from an emotional standpoint, from a success standpoint,
and we can make you feel like you're in a unique situation here where we'll treat you
as an individual and we'll do the very best we can to help you achieve your goal.
We look for unique situations for our patients.
We try to tailor what their individual needs are.
I think the importance between our center and other centers would be, we're very upfront
with patients, we let them know what their expectations to get pregnant are, we let
them know what it's going to take to get pregnant, we know financially what it's going
to take for them to get pregnant.
In addition, we offer numerous treatments, we offer inseminations, we put sperm inside
the womb, we offer in vitro-feralization, we'll put embryos inside the womb.
We can offer surgery, we can offer fertility medications, and there's a host of other things
we can offer patients at the center, everything under one roof for the convenience of our patients.
Our typical first patient appointment is where we'll actually spend probably about an hour
talking about things, we'll talk about their history, we'll talk about possible evaluations
they may need, and they'll even start talking about potential treatments.
When we talk about treatments, we'll let them know what their chances of getting pregnant
are, how much it's going to cost, and what do they need to do.
And so we really try to evaluate it thoroughly so we don't miss anything so we can give them
the best options to get pregnant.
We're very proud of our egg donation program in Surrogacy, we're known internationally
for that, so it's not just Fort Worth, you think, oh, we just get doing things in Fort
Worth, but we really see patients from all over the United States and all over the globe,
and we're honored enough to be able to treat those type of patients here in Fort Worth.
Other aspect here at Fort Worth fatalities are staff, I think we have an outstanding
staff, and we all need to work as a team to get the job done.
We do know there's a lot in tailed in helping our patients get pregnant, but we do try to
find a cost effective means to try to get our patients pregnant and give them our best
advice on how to accomplish that.

youtube_description:
http://bestdocsnetwork.com/dallas-and-fort-worth/robert-kaufmann/

Reproductive Endocrinologist Dr. Robert Kaufmann of Ft. Worth Fertility makes it clear that his number one goal is to help couples get pregnant. Dr. Kaufmann believes that his facility is best equipped to accomplish just that. His practice offers the highest level of multi-dimensional patient care. From a success standpoint, and from an emotional standpoint, you won't find a better or more supportive Fertility practice anywhere. Learn more on the Best Docs Network.
